Title: Deprecation of webview sign-in support announcement from Google

Body.Content:
Google recently announced that starting on January 4, 2021, embedded webview sign-in support will be deprecated. Customers using Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) B2B collaboration with Google accounts or External Identities self-service sign-up using Gmail may be affected and should test line of business native applications for compatibility. 

To learn what applications may be affected and take action, please read the documentation.
